provenance.capture: libpq PQexec with two retained connections in a disposable Docker PostgreSQL 18.4 database

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE ps_reference(label text, stamp timestamptz)
CREATE FUNCTION ps_function() RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS 'SELECT 1'
CREATE VIEW ps_view AS SELECT id FROM ps_used

PREPARE ps_probe AS SELECT 'now'::timestamptz=stamp AS original_input, 'now'::timestamptz=now() AS current_input, (SELECT count(*) FROM ps_used) AS dependency_value FROM ps_reference WHERE label='data_only'

PREPARE ps_probe AS SELECT 'now'::timestamptz=stamp AS original_input, 'now'::timestamptz=now() AS current_input, (SELECT count(*) FROM ps_used) AS dependency_value FROM ps_reference WHERE label='unrelated_relation'
ALTER TABLE ps_unrelated ADD COLUMN extra int

PREPARE ps_probe AS SELECT 'now'::timestamptz=stamp AS original_input, 'now'::timestamptz=now() AS current_input, (SELECT count(*) FROM ps_used) AS dependency_value FROM ps_reference WHERE label='related_relation'
ALTER TABLE ps_used ADD COLUMN extra int
PREPARE ps_probe AS SELECT 'now'::timestamptz=stamp AS original_input, 'now'::timestamptz=now() AS current_input, ps_function() AS dependency_value FROM ps_reference WHERE label='same_routine'
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ps_function() RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS 'SELECT 1'

PREPARE ps_probe AS SELECT 'now'::timestamptz=stamp AS original_input, 'now'::timestamptz=now() AS current_input, (SELECT count(*) FROM ps_used) AS dependency_value FROM ps_reference WHERE label='peer_rollback'
ALTER TABLE ps_used ADD COLUMN undone int
PREPARE ps_probe AS SELECT 'now'::timestamptz=stamp AS original_input, 'now'::timestamptz=now() AS current_input, (1::ps_domain)::int AS dependency_value FROM ps_reference WHERE label='domain_checks'
ALTER DOMAIN ps_domain ADD CONSTRAINT positive CHECK(VALUE>1)

steps.sql: ALTER DOMAIN ps_domain DROP CONSTRAINT positive

PREPARE ps_probe AS SELECT 'now'::timestamptz=stamp AS original_input, 'now'::timestamptz=now() AS current_input, (SELECT count(*) FROM ps_used) AS dependency_value FROM ps_reference WHERE label='namespace'

PREPARE ps_probe AS SELECT 'now'::timestamptz=stamp AS original_input, 'now'::timestamptz=now() AS current_input, (SELECT count(*) FROM ps_view) AS dependency_value FROM ps_reference WHERE label='related_view'
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ps_view AS SELECT id FROM ps_used
